angle_correction.title: Angle Correction
angle_correction.description: 1D piecewise-linear azimuth correction applied to tracker output

outside_policy.title: Outside Policy
outside_policy.description: Correction policy for azimuths beyond the calibration node range. Clamp=0 uses the nearest boundary node's correction; None=1 applies no correction.

edge_handling.title: Edge Handling
edge_handling.description: Post-calibration handling for detections whose corrected azimuth exceeds ±edge_clip_deg. Clip=0 clamps; Drop=1 removes the track; None=2 is a no-op.

edge_clip_deg.title: Edge Clip Angle [deg]
edge_clip_deg.description: Azimuth threshold in degrees used by clip/drop edge handling

measured_deg.title: Angle Correction [deg]
measured_deg.description: What the sensor reports at each true node position (enter the sensor reading when the target is at that angle)

macro_sensitivity.title: Macro Sensitivity
macro_sensitivity.description: Sensitivity for dynamic target detection. 1.0 = maximum sensitivity (base thresholds). Lower values raise confirm/unconfirm thresholds, reducing false dynamic tracks at the cost of slower confirmation.

micro_sensitivity.title: Micro Sensitivity
micro_sensitivity.description: Sensitivity for static target detection. 1.0 = maximum sensitivity (base thresholds). Lower values raise confirm/unconfirm thresholds, reducing false static tracks at the cost of slower confirmation.

safe_mode_as_default.title: Safe Mode
safe_mode_as_default.description: When enabled, dynamic track creation requires a prior confirmed dynamic track within the configured timeout. Reduces false positives in environments with strong static clutter.

room_size_detection.title: Room Size Detection
room_size_detection.description: When enabled, the tracker automatically learns the room boundaries from confirmed dynamic tracks and restricts new track creation to the detected room extent.
